questions.question: By the time I finished my homework, it was already midnight. I had been studying for three hours.
options: I had studied for two hours
I had not studied at all
I had just started to study
I had been studying for three hours
questions.answer: I had been studying for three hours

questions.question: This is the biggest city in Europe. It has a population of over 14 million people.
options: It is bigger than Paris
It is smaller than London
It is the most populous city in the world
It is the capital of Germany
questions.answer: It has a population of over 14 million people

questions.question: If I had more money, I would travel around the world.
options: I will travel around the world next year
I have already traveled to many countries
I don't want to travel because it's too expensive
I am planning to move abroad
questions.answer: If I had more money, I would travel around the world

questions.question: The manager suggested that we should increase production by 20%.
options: The manager said we should decrease production
The manager agreed with our plan to reduce costs
We decided to follow the manager's advice
The manager recommended a 10% increase in production
questions.answer: The manager suggested that we should increase production by 20%

questions.question: I was so tired after working all day, I could hardly speak.
options: I felt very happy and energetic
I had a great time with my friends
I was feeling quite relaxed
I was extremely exhausted
questions.answer: I was so tired after working all day

questions.question: The new policy aims to reduce pollution in our city by encouraging people to use public transport.
options: The government wants to increase traffic congestion
The policy will lead to a significant decrease in air quality
The goal is to make our city more environmentally friendly
The policy will not have any impact on pollution
questions.answer: The new policy aims to reduce pollution in our city by encouraging people to use public transport

questions.question: I'm not sure if I'll be able to attend the party tonight. It depends on my schedule.
options: I will definitely come
I won't go because it's too late
Maybe, but I haven't decided yet
It's already tomorrow
questions.answer: I'm not sure if I'll be able to attend the party tonight

questions.question: The company is considering outsourcing some of its tasks to reduce costs.
options: They want to increase their employee numbers
They are planning to invest in new technology
They will definitely not outsource any tasks
They aim to become more efficient
questions.answer: The company is considering outsourcing some of its tasks to reduce costs

options: My favorite genre is romance
I prefer watching movies over reading
I'm not much into fiction
I enjoy reading all types of literature
questions.answer: I love reading books, especially science fiction and fantasy
